I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on Monday, November 3, 2025.

- **Source:** Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 11/2/2025 says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's own cutover recap note from Dec 8 also gives November 3 as the official handoff.
- **Day-to-day handoff:** The same recap says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21 for the terminal cutover. Kwame fully took over on November 22.

I told her to use Nov 3 for the official change of ownership, or Nov 22 if the tracker wants the day Kwame started working it day to day.
